chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from a man, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man forgot the ṭawāf al-nisāʾ until he had gone in to his wife? He said: Women are not lawful for him until he visits the House. And he said: He should instruct that it be performed on his behalf if he does not perform hajj; and if he dies before ṭawāf is performed on his behalf, then his guardian or someone else should perform it on his behalf.

key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the circumambulation required in hajj after which marital relations become lawful
key_terms.لَا يَحِلُّ: it is not lawful or permitted
key_terms.يَزُورَ الْبَيْتَ: he goes to the Sacred House to perform the required visitation rite
key_terms.يُقْضَى عَنْهُ: it is fulfilled or made up on his behalf

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets ṭawāf al-nisāʾ and returns to his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets ṭawāf al-nisāʾ and then returns to marital relations. It states that women remain unlawful for him until he performs the required rite, and if he is unable or dies before doing so, it should be fulfilled on his behalf.
